name: Sri Trang Gloves (Thailand) Public Company Limited
summary: Sri Trang Gloves (Thailand) Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and distributes rubber gloves in Asia, North America, South America, Europe, and internationally. It operates in two segments: Gloves and Other Businesses. The company offers latex powdered, latex powder-free, nitrile powder-free, and gamma ray sterile examination gloves under various brand names for a range of applications, including healthcare and medical, agriculture and chemical, food processing and handling, manufacturing, and operations.
